traitor.goal: Awaken the ancient Mummy and sacrifice the explorers to complete your dark rebirth ritual.
rules: You control the Mummy during your turn.
The Mummy rolls 5 dice in Might attacks.
You win when all heroes are slain or sacrificed.

heroes.goal: Decipher the ancient hieroglyphics and banish the Mummy with sacred incantations.
rules: Find the Book or Holy Symbol to cast banishment spells.
Make Knowledge rolls (target 5+) in the Crypt to seal the sarcophagus.
Heroes win when the sarcophagus is sealed or the Mummy is destroyed.

traitor.goal: Summon the Restless Spirit to consume the sanity of the living.
rules: The Spirit can pass through walls and moves at Speed 4.
Spirit attacks target Sanity rather than Might.
Traitor wins when all heroes die or go completely insane.

heroes.goal: Find the spirit remains and lay them to rest in consecrated ground.
rules: Search the house for 3 sacred relics.
Bring relics to the Chapel or Pentagram Chamber.
Heroes win when the ritual of peace is performed.

traitor.goal: Brew the Witch brew by boiling the frogs and explorers.
rules: Feed the cauldron in the Kitchen.

heroes.goal: Spill the cauldron and extinguish the cursed fire.
rules: Make Might checks in the Kitchen.

traitor.goal: Trap the heroes in giant spider webs and feed the Broodmother.
rules: Spiders spin webs that cost 2 extra movement to leave.

heroes.goal: Burn the web nests and slay the Broodmother.
rules: Use torches or weapons against the giant spider.

traitor.goal: You have transformed into a ferocious Werewolf. Feast upon your former companions!
rules: Gain +2 Might and +2 Speed in wolf form.
You take damage only from the Spear or silver weapons.
Traitor wins when all heroes are slain.

heroes.goal: Forge a silver weapon or find the Spear to slay the beast.
rules: Search for the Spear or forge silver in the Furnace Room.
Attack the Werewolf with silver to inflict mortal wounds.
Heroes win when the Werewolf is slain.

traitor.goal: Stare them into submission.

heroes.goal: Blind the cosmic horror.

traitor.goal: Feed the carnivorous plants.

heroes.goal: Weed-killer the plant roots.

traitor.goal: Complete the dark coven pact.

heroes.goal: Disrupt the ritual circles.

traitor.goal: Force everyone to dance until their hearts burst.

heroes.goal: Smash the enchanted music box.

traitor.goal: Drag the chosen hero into the abyss through the mirrors.
rules: Travel instantaneously between rooms with mirrors.
Phantoms drain Knowledge and Sanity with their icy touch.
Traitor wins when the chosen hero is captured.

heroes.goal: Shatter the cursed mirrors and banish the Phantom to the ether.
rules: Locate mirrors throughout the mansion.
Roll Might 4+ to smash each mirror.
Heroes win when all 4 mirrors are shattered.

traitor.goal: Feed the hungry blob.

heroes.goal: Freeze the gelatinous horror.

traitor.goal: Turn all intruders to stone statues.

heroes.goal: Reflect the Medusa gaze.

traitor.goal: Overwhelm the house with zombies.

heroes.goal: Board up doors and survive.

traitor.goal: Lure the creature to feast.

heroes.goal: Electrocute the creature.

traitor.goal: Hatch and nurture the great red dragon.

heroes.goal: Slay the dragon before it incinerates the house.

traitor.goal: Trap the heroes in collapsing subterranean tunnels and bury them alive.
rules: At the end of each round, a room collapses into rubble.
Collapsed rooms cannot be entered.
Traitor wins when all heroes are trapped or killed.

heroes.goal: Dig a way out to the surface before the mansion crumbles entirely.
rules: Reach the Balcony, Gardens, or Tower to find an exit.
Make Knowledge or Might rolls to clear escape paths.
Heroes win when at least half the heroes escape.

rules: Traitor acts after all heroes.
Traitor controls scenario monsters if any.

heroes.goal: Hero objective for Haunt 17. Cooperate and defeat the evil!
rules: Explore the house to find scenario items or defeat the traitor.
